content: First-pass evidence ledger, cannabis indications. STRONG human RCT (clinical-benefit language earned, only four): (1) CBD/Epidiolex for Dravet/Lennox-Gastaut/TSC seizures, multiple Phase III, FDA-approved 2018, strongest indication in cannabis medicine; (2) oral cannabinoids dronabinol/nabilone for chemo-induced nausea/vomiting refractory to first-line, FDA-approved 1985, but mostly NOT head-to-head vs modern 5-HT3/NK1 antagonists; (3) nabiximols for MS spasticity, patient-reported, approved 29 countries not US, clinician-measured Ashworth effects smaller/inconsistent; (4) modest analgesia in chronic neuropathic pain, meta-analyses positive but small (~6-9pts/100) and CONTESTED by 2026 Cochrane update finding no clear evidence. PHASE III FAILURES / RCT-NULL (advocacy outruns evidence): cancer pain (Sativex Ph III 2015 all failed), cancer cachexia (Strasser JCO 2006 stopped for futility), Tourette (CANNA-TICS 2023 failed primary), Parkinson motor symptoms (Thanabalasingam 2021 meta-null), depression/anxiety/PTSD (Wilson Lancet Psychiatry 2026, 54 RCTs, no benefit), glaucoma (AAO opposes). IBD critical nuance: symptoms improve WITHOUT inflammation reduction (CRP/calprotectin/endoscopy unchanged) — masks disease, does not modify it.
